flags.why: The slats of cửa chớp can be fixed, so specifying adjustable slats incorrectly restricts the meaning ([source](https://cuantp.com/cua-chop-la-gi/)).
Cuốn chiếu does not mean to summarise main points; its established figurative meaning concerns completing work progressively ([source](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/cuốn_chiếu)).
The entry omits the common agricultural meaning of harvesting less than normal ([source](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/thất_thu)).
flags.fix: to have a poor harvest; to suffer a shortfall in crop yield
